_note: Steps that make a game model from a ComfyUI run (ASSET_PIPELINE.md 'Image to model'): the record art-manifest/comfy/<id>.json lists them and tools/blender/make.mjs build <id> does them in order on the run's detailed model (art-src/comfy/<id>/<run.file>), writing the record's game file beside it. Positions are shares (0 to 1) of the model's box in its game placement (the record's frame: z up, facing +y). Types: int, number, bool, enum (values), vec (a list of len numbers), boxes (lists of six numbers x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1). A new kind is an entry here plus its arguments in make.mjs (STEP_ARGS).

bend.what: Turn a part of the detailed model about a joint, paint and maps untouched (the bone hound's head raised 20 degrees at the neck, so its open jaw faces the game camera). Each corner turns by angle x its weight: 0 behind blend[0], 1 past blend[1] (along y), only above `above` (z). Before finish.

finish.what: The game version of the detailed model: a solid rebuild (cells voxels across), cut to `triangles` (the model's budget), fresh UVs in a few large charts packed by xatlas, and the detailed model's paint, roughness, metal and normals baked onto them at `texture` px. metal: none (stone, bone, wood, cloth, flesh), mixed (decided per material), all (by colour), keep (as Pixal made it); metalRegions {boxes, rough} where the metal is when Pixal marks the whole model metal. keep {boxes, share}: parts the cut takes last, so they hold that share of the triangles (a jaw and its fangs). hard: sharp edges kept (smooth by `angle` degrees).

place.what: Move the model into its game placement (the record's frame, found by make.mjs fit). After finish, before rig.

grime.what: Dirt painted into the colour (and roughness) of a model that came out too clean: film everywhere, crevice grime, stains, mud from the feet, dust on top, old-bone yellowing (age), all scaled by amount. After place (it needs the game's up).

rig.what: A skeleton built from the placed model's shape, the body skinned by geodesic voxel binding. body: quad (four legs: Root, Hip, Spine1-2, Chest, Neck1-2, Head, Tail_A-D, FL/FR_Upper/Lower/Paw, HL/HR_Thigh/Shin/Meta/Paw; legTop 0.8 when hanging cloth meets the legs low), legs (any number of legs around one body, a spider's eight: Root, Hip, Abdomen, Head, <side><n>_Upper/Lower/Foot), biped (the heroes' skeleton on a body in a T or A pose, the body turned to face +X like every hero body). No clips: they are Blender jobs (a motion on tools/blender/recipes/<id>.json; a biped's, a retarget from hero_gravecaller). Last.
